steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: You can take your whole client list out of the ConstructHUB CRM as a spreadsheet file.

steps.caption: Export CSV
steps.narration: On Clients, the button is Export CSV.

steps.caption: Download the file
steps.narration: Click it, and your browser saves the file. The page stays where it is.

steps.caption: One row per client
steps.narration: The file has one row for every client, sorted by name.

steps.caption: Email and phone
steps.narration: Each row has the client's email and phone,

steps.caption: Address
steps.narration: their address, city, state and ZIP,

steps.caption: Notes and date added
steps.narration: plus your intake notes, and the date the client was added.

steps.caption: Tabs do not change the export
steps.narration: Export doesn't follow the tab you're on, or what you've searched for.

steps.caption: Always the whole list
steps.narration: Even with Job Won showing, Export CSV gives you every client.

steps.caption: Import
steps.narration: Import, right beside it, is for bringing clients in from another system.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find Export CSV on Clients, in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to export your client list | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Export CSV in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will download your client list as a spreadsheet file, see what each row holds, and learn that the export is always the whole list.
